### Fixed
- **An uninstall with the bundled engine completes: the engine is removed after Helm's delete pass** ([#708](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/issues/708)). The pre-delete hook at weight 5 deleted the `FluxInstance`, the operator then uninstalled Flux with its CRDs, and Helm's pass, which builds every object of the release before deleting any, failed on the first `HelmRelease` whose kind was no longer served (`resource mapping not found … ensure CRDs are installed first`), leaving the release `uninstalling`, a retry failing the same way. The `FluxInstance` and the Flux Operator's `Deployment`, `ServiceAccount` and `ClusterRoleBinding` carry `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`, so Helm's pass neither builds nor deletes them and Flux is served until it is over; the post-delete hooks `teardown-engine` (weight 0: delete the `FluxInstance` and wait for Flux to be uninstalled) and `teardown-operator` (weight 5: delete the operator's three objects) remove the engine after it. The hook identity and its network policy render at post-delete too. Switching `components.flux.enabled` off in place now leaves the engine running outside the release; the README names what to delete. `make verify-engine`, `verify-self` and `verify-hooks-netpol` assert the hooks, their events and the kept objects.
